comments.author: whatyoucantsay
comments.story: A Lesson from the Biggest Losers: Exercise Keeps Off the Weight
comments.why: Ultrarunner winning on nachos, candy and beer.
comments.text: Then how did Courtney Dauwalter recently win the MOAB 240 race in Utah by over eight hours on a diet of nachos, candy and beer? She eats far more calories than a normal human could and is establishing new high marks in performance along the way. Not even the Tarahumara have put up her kind of numbers. [VIDEO] A single hour on the treadmill will burn over 1,000 kcal for most somewhat fit people. It also increases their insulin sensitivity. The truth is most westerners and especially Americans are far too sedentary.
